
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper03" title="发布于 2025-11-28 08:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（3）聊天记录持久化到数据库</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251127214215878-130893370.png" alt="MAF快速入门（3）聊天记录持久化到数据库" class="desc_img">
        上一篇，我们学习了MAF对于单个Agent的花样玩法，其中提到了聊天记录的持久化存储。本篇，我们来继续实践一下将聊天记录持久化到关系型数据库，这样用户在中断会话后返回时还能从上次断开的地方继续对话，提供给用户不间断的体验。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper02" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们学习了MAF对于单个Agent的花样玩法，其中提到了聊天记录的持久化存储<span>。本篇，我们来继续实践一下将聊天记录持久化到关系型数据库，这样用户在中断会话后返回时还能从上次断开的地方继续对话，提供给用户不间断的体验。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>准备工作</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span><span>在今天的这个案例中，我们创建了一个.NET控制台应用程序，安装了以下NuGet包：</span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span><span><span>我们的配置文件中定义了LLM API的信息：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EndPoint</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.siliconflow.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApiKey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">******************************</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ModelId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>这里我们使用 SiliconCloud 提供<span><span>的<span><span>&nbsp;Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct&nbsp;<span><span>模型，你<span><span>可以通过这个URL注册账号：<span><span><a href="https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW</a><span>&nbsp;获取大量免费的Token来进行本次实验。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>然后，我们将配置文件中的API信息读取出来：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddJsonFile($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, optional: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, reloadOnChange: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> openAIProvider = config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;OpenAIProvider&gt;();</pre>
</div>
<h1><span>数据库初始化</span></h1>
<p><span><span>为了将聊天记录持久化，我们定一个CustomChatHistory类来记录每次对话的内容：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomChatHistory
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Context { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DateTime CreatedTime { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; } 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> CustomChatHistory(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context)
    {
        Id </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        Context </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context;
        CreatedTime </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>然后，基于EF Core实现一个DbContext，这是老操作了：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatHistoryDbContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;CustomChatHistory&gt; ChatHistories { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=ChatHistoryDb.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>有了DbContext后续我们就可以往数据库中写数据了。</span></span></p>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-bottom: 16px;margin-top: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">创建一个AI Agent</span></h1>
<p><span><span>通过MAF快速创建一个专注于回答马自达汽车知识的Agent：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mazdaAgent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .CreateAIAgent(name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Powerful Assistant</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, instructions: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You are a helpful assistant who responds user message in Mazda cars.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot; outline: 0px; visibility: visible; line-height: 1.75em; margin-bottom: 16px; margin-top: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">开始第一轮对话</span></h1>
<p><span><span>开启第一轮对话，我们想了解下Mazda 3这款车：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> userMessage = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello, can you tell me about the Mazda 3?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User&gt; {userMessage}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> thread =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mazdaAgent.GetNewThread();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> agentResponse = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mazdaAgent.RunAsync(userMessage, thread);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent&gt; {agentResponse}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>执行结果下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251127213852351-1668056159.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>可以看到，它洋洋洒洒地用了很多文字给我们介绍马三这款车。</span></span></p>
<h1><span><span>对话记录持久化</span></span></h1>
<p><span><span>假设我们这时要接一个电话，暂时就不跟Agent对话了。那么，Agent需要将对话记录存下来，这里我们就需要进行AgentThread的序列化并将其存到数据库：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> serializedThread =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> thread.Serialize(JsonSerializerOptions.Web).GetRawText();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> chatConversation = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomChatHistory(serializedThread);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> dbContext = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatHistoryDbContext();
dbContext.Database.EnsureCreated();
dbContext.ChatHistories.Add(chatConversation);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();</pre>
</div>
<p>这里我们存入的是一个Sqlite文件数据库，主要用于演示，十分便捷。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251127213930050-150751467.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>假设过了几分钟，我们接完电话回来准备继续对话了，Agent系统需要再从数据库中将我们的对话记录读取出来，也就是进行AgentThread的反序列化：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> savedConversation = dbContext.ChatHistories.First(c =&gt; c.Id ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chatConversation.Id);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> loadedThread = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;JsonElement&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(savedConversation.Context, JsonSerializerOptions.Web);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resumedThread = mazdaAgent.DeserializeThread(loadedThread, JsonSerializerOptions.Web);</pre>
</div>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;line-height: 1.75em;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;3 3 [\&quot;para\&quot;,{\&quot;tagName\&quot;:\&quot;section\&quot;,\&quot;attributes\&quot;:{\&quot;style\&quot;:\&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;\&quot;},\&quot;namespaceURI\&quot;:\&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml\&quot;}]&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot; outline: 0px; visibility: visible; line-height: 1.75em; margin-bottom: 16px; margin-top: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">开始第二轮对话</span></h1>
<p><span><span>我们刚刚问了Mazda 3这款车的基本信息，现在我们想了解下这款车的一些特性。这里，我直接问“What are the feautres of this car?”，这个 this car 就需要结合上下文才能知道我问的是哪一款车。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>userMessage = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">What are the features of this car?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">User&gt; {userMessage}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
agentResponse </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mazdaAgent.RunAsync(userMessage, resumedThread);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Agent&gt; {agentResponse}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>执行结果如下图所示：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>首先，通过debug我们可以看到反序列化出来的AgentThread的确是包含了我们第一轮的对话记录：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251127214017344-1946398998.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>其次，Agent在聊天记录的基础上回答这个问题的结果如下：</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202511/381412-20251127214031251-274481293.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span><span>由上图可以看出，Agent准确的分析到了我们所说的 this car 指的是之前聊到的 Mazda 3这款车，并给了我们一些这款车的特性，清晰准确！</span></span></p>
<h1><span>小结</span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了如何将Agent中的聊天记录持久化到数据库中，这对于保持用户对话体验十分重要。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将继续MAF的学习。</p>
